REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION
TUESDAY - DECEMBER 9, 2025 - 07:00 P.M.
CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at cerritos.gov and at the Community Development Department, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 2nd floor, Cerritos, CA, 90703 during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the Commission after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection at the Community Development Department during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to economic_development@cerritos.gov or by phone at (562) 916-1201 during regular business hours.
Order of Agenda
The Commission, by majority of those members present, may reorder the business items listed on the agenda.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at cerritos.gov, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or in person in the Council Chamber.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in person at the meeting or or in writing as described below.
In-person public comment : Public comment on business agenda items will be opened and may be provided during consideration of that business agenda item. Public comment on Consent Calendar and non-agenda items will be opened and may be provided during Agenda Item No. 4.
Written public comment (hard copy or email) : Public comment may be submitted via email to economic_development@cerritos.gov or by hard copy to the Community Development Department no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the Commission prior to the meeting and retained with the official meeting record.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Community Development Department at (562) 916-1201 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.

This section is reserved for public comment on Consent Calendar and items not listed on the agenda but that are within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Commission. Verbal comments may be limited to three minutes per speaker, subject to the Chair extending to a maximum of five minutes per speaker, with a total time allotted not to exceed 45 minutes unless the Chair extends.
5.
Consent Calendar
Items listed under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by one motion. Subject to the discretion of the Commission, there will be no separate discussion of these items. If a Commission member requests separate consideration, the item may be removed from the Consent Calendar and considered separately.

During this part of the meeting, designated staff will have an opportunity to report on various City matters and/or respond verbally to questions or comments from the prior meeting, including any request by members to provide a brief supplemental report or brief follow-up response to items from the prior meeting agenda.

During this part of the meeting, members may provide brief reports to the community on various matters of interest, including any mandated reports required by AB 1234. Pursuant to the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act and the City of Cerritos Commission and Committee Scope of Authority Policy, there may be no discussion or action taken on any matters presented during this item or that are not listed on the meeting agenda.

CITY OF CERRITOS

  MINUTES

Regular Economic Development Commission Meeting
December 9, 2025
City Council Chambers
18125 Bloomfield Ave
Cerritos, California 90703

PRESENT:  Commissioner Kenneth Chiang
  Commissioner Brian Hews
  Commissioner Aris Tagle
  Vice Chair Grace Hu
  Chair Alfred Reyes Jr.

PRESENT:  Deputy City Manager/Acting Director of Community Development Ryan Carey
  Theater Executive Director Jeff Thielke
  Director of Public Works/City Engineer Alvin Papa
  Assistant Director of Public Works Chris Kuebert
  Economic Development Manager Kiana Miranda
  Advance Planning Manager Sabrina Chan
  Marketing Administrator Glenn Arnade

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Commissioner Hews.

3.  Roll Call

  All Members of the Economic Development Commission were declared present.

4.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  Chair Reyes invited comments and suggestions from the public on items not listed on
  the agenda. Seeing and hearing no one wishing to address the Economic
  Development Commission, Chair Reyes closed public comments.

5.  Consent Calendar

5A.  Approval of Minutes

  Tuesday, November 12, 2025, 7:00 p.m. Economic Development Commission Special
  Meeting Minutes.

  MOTION: It was moved by Vice Chair Hu, and seconded by Commissioner Chiang,
  to approve the Tuesday, November 12, 2025, 7:00 p.m. Economic Development
  Commission Special Meeting Minutes.

City of Cerritos  December 9, 2025
Economic Development Commission Meeting Minutes  Page 1
   The motion carried (4-0-0-1) as follows:

  AYES:  Chiang, Tagle, Hu, Reyes
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  Hews

6.  New and Old Business

6A.  Review and consideration of an informational presentation by the Public Works
  Department of the proposed water and sewer rate adjustments.

  A staff report was given by Director of Public Works/City Engineer Alvin Papa and
  Assistant Director of Public Works Chris Kuebert. A PowerPoint presentation was
  displayed, providing details about the City of Cerritos current water and sewer
  infrastructure, what services residents are currently paying for and the proposed
  water and sewer rate adjustments. The presentation provided an overview of the
  current conditions of the City’s four (4) ground water wells and proposed water and
  sewer rate adjustments to help maintain reliable and safe water service to Cerritos
  residents.

  Discussion continued with the Commission regarding the impacts to the City if
  the necessary repairs are not made. Specifically, questions about emergency
  repair costs and potential public health impacts were discussed.

  Chair Reyes opened public comment. Cerritos resident Robert provided comments in
  opposition to the proposed water and sewer rate adjustments and his concerns of
  the cost to Cerritos residents. Seeing and hearing no other speakers wishing to
  address the Economic Development Commission, Chair Reyes closed public
  comments. The Economic Development Commission received and filed the report.

6B.  Review and consideration of an informational report regarding business safety
  and security resources provided by the Los Angeles County Sheriff’s Department
  (LASD).

  A verbal report was given by Los Angeles County Sheriff Sergeant Alfred Lio.
  Sergeant Lio provided an overview of commercial crime statistics within the City
  of Cerritos. Sergeant Lio highlighted the ongoing partnership between the LASD
  and loss prevention staff at the Los Cerritos Mall and local shopping centers.
  Sergeant Lio concluded his presentation by sharing practical safety tips offered
  to businesses that enhance security during the holiday season, and year-round,
  and provided information on available resources that support maintaining a safe
  and secure business environment in Cerritos.

  Chair Reyes opened public comment. Seeing and hearing no speakers, Chair Reyes
  declared the public hearing closed.

  Discussion continued with the Commission regarding security improvements within
  commercial and residential properties, theft trends during the holiday season and
  what the LASD does to combat the spike in people visiting the shopping centers. The
  Economic Development Commission received and filed the report.

City of Cerritos  December 9, 2025
Economic Development Commission Meeting Minutes  Page 2
 6C.  Review and consideration of an informational report regarding 2025 progress
  toward City of Cerritos Strategic Plan Goal #4 — Strengthen Economic
  Development.

  A staff report was given by Economic Development Manager Kiana Miranda. A
  PowerPoint presentation was displayed, providing details about the City of
  Cerritos Strategic Plan Goal #4 — Strengthen Economic Development. Ms.
  Miranda explained that Goal #4 focuses on supporting business retention and
  attraction, strengthening partnerships with property owners and regional
  organizations, and adapting City programs to meet current marketplace needs.
  Ms. Miranda provided an overview outlining accomplishments during 2025 that
  are associated with Goal #4 and summarized ongoing efforts that support
  business development and economic vitality within the community.

  Discussion continued with the Commission regarding the Economic Development
  Strategic Plan (EDSP) and the Commission's opportunity to provide feedback
  before formal adoption. The Commission discussed the role of the Business
  Spotlight Program in recognizing local businesses and supporting the Cerritos
  community. The Economic Development Commission received and filed the
  report.

7.  Reports

7A.  Reports from Designated Commission Liaison

  There were no reports from the Designated Commission Liaison to the Economic
  Development Commission.

7B.  Reports from Planning Commission Members

  Reports were given by Commissioner Hews, Commissioner Tagle, Vice Chair Hu, and
  Chair Reyes.

  The commission provided consensus direction for a summer music series at the
  Cerritos Towne Center.

8.  Adjournment

  The meeting adjourned at 8:52 p.m.

  /s/Kiana Miranda
  Kiana Miranda
  Secretary

/s/Alfred Reyes Jr.
